column1: # Differences between this registry and the release plan's section 3.2 table that are allowed
# while the M2 substrate stack is open. The plan is generated from the registry as it stands
# when the whole stack has merged. A layer states only what it holds, so before the last layer
# a row of the table can name a status or an "In CI by" that this layer's registry does not
# have yet. TestRegistryAgreesWithThePlan accepts exactly these rows and fails on a difference
# that is not listed here and on a listed row that no longer differs, so the list can only
# shrink, and the last layer of the stack has none (this file is deleted there).
# Columns: identifier, status here, "In CI by" here, the layer that closes the difference.
